capabilities: Capture entries in a hotkey-triggered modal
File entries as dated bullets under a configured heading
Send entries to an inbox note or copy them to the clipboard
Browse configured categories and recent-note lists to pick a target note
Configure timestamps, bullet format, and discard confirmation
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README covers settings and key behavior in detail but gives no usage examples or screenshots.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture a short entry from anywhere and append it as a timestamped bullet to a chosen note without opening and editing that note manually.
summary: Quick-capture modal that files typed entries as dated bullets under a heading in any chosen note, or sends them to an inbox note.
